## Read copynumber variation for accessions
```{r}
# List all .cnt files in the folder
cnt_files <- list.files(
  path = "/groups/nordborg/projects/ddm1_resilencing/03_processing/007_allele_specific_expression/pannagram/simsearch_out",
  pattern = "\\.cnt$",
  full.names = TRUE
)

for (file in cnt_files) {
  df <- read.table(
    file,
    sep = "\t",
    header = TRUE,
    check.names = FALSE,
    row.names = 1
  )
  
  # Extract accession from the first column name
  first_col <- colnames(df)[1]
  accession_id <- sub(".*_(\\d+)", "\\1", first_col)
  
  # Rename the 'total' column to include the accession ID
  colnames(df)[colnames(df) == "total"] <- paste0("total_", accession_id)
  
  # Add accession column
  df$accession <- accession_id
  
  # Output filename
  new_filename <- sub("\\.cnt$", "_with_accession.cnt", file)
  
  write.table(df, new_filename, sep = "\t", row.names = TRUE, quote = FALSE)
}


```
### Add ID column
```{bash}
for file in *scaffolds_85_85_with_accession.cnt; do
  awk -F'\t' 'BEGIN{OFS="\t"} NR==1 {print "ID_cleaned", $0; next} {split($1, a, "|"); print a[1], $0}' "$file" > tmp && mv tmp "$file"
done

## Extract only 1st and 7th column from every file 
for file in *scaffolds_85_85_with_accession.cnt; do
  cut -f 1,6 "$file" > tmp && mv tmp "$file"
done
```
## Read files and merge them 
```{r}
# List relevant files
files <- list.files(
  path = "/groups/nordborg/projects/ddm1_resilencing/03_processing/007_allele_specific_expression/pannagram/simsearch_out",
  pattern = "scaffolds_85_85_with_accession.cleaned\\.cnt$",
  full.names = TRUE
)


# Read files, extract columns 1 and 6
cnt_list <- lapply(files, function(f) {
  df <- read.table(f, header = TRUE) 
  colnames(df) <- c("ID", f)  # Rename for merging
  return(df)
})

# Merge all by 'ID' (inner join, keeps only shared IDs)
merged_df <- Reduce(function(x, y) merge(x, y, by = "ID_cleaned"), cnt_list)
merged_df$Chr5_100584 <- NULL
```
## Keep all IDs
```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(readr)
library(purrr)
library(stringr)

files <- list.files(
  path = "/groups/nordborg/projects/ddm1_resilencing/03_processing/007_allele_specific_expression/pannagram/simsearch_out",
  pattern = "scaffolds_85_85_with_accession.cleaned\\.cnt$",
  full.names = TRUE
)

# Helper to read and standardize each file
read_cnt <- function(f) {
  df <- read.table(f, header = TRUE, sep = "", stringsAsFactors = FALSE, check.names = FALSE)
  # Expect a column with ID. If it's called "ID_cleaned", use it; adjust if needed.
  stopifnot("ID_cleaned" %in% names(df))
  # Keep only ID and the value column you need. Here I assume column 6 is the value.
  # If you truly want col 1 and 6: change 'value = df[[6]]' accordingly, and ensure ID_cleaned is col 1.
  tibble(
    ID_cleaned = df[["ID_cleaned"]],
    value = df[[6]]
  ) |>
    distinct() |>
    mutate(source = basename(f))
}

cnt_list <- map(files, read_cnt)

# Convert to wide format with one column per file
merged_df <- cnt_list |>
  list_rbind() |>
  mutate(source = str_remove(source, "\\.cnt$")) |>
  tidyr::pivot_wider(
    id_cols = ID_cleaned,
    names_from = source,
    values_from = value
  ) |>
  arrange(ID_cleaned)

# Optionally drop a specific column if present
merged_df$Chr5_100584 <- NULL

merged_df_selected <-merged_df[merged_df$ID_cleaned=="AT4TE10165",]
```

## Change ids to the accession names according to the file
```{r}
real_accession_names <- read.table("/groups/nordborg/projects/ddm1_resilencing/01_data/full_genomes/unique_columns_output_tair10_6909.txt")
colnames(real_accession_names) <- c("id", "accession")


old_cols <- colnames(merged_df)[-1]

# Extract the numeric part after "total_"
ids <- sub("total_", "", old_cols)

# Match those IDs with accession numbers
accessions <- real_accession_names$accession[match(ids, real_accession_names$id)]

# Create new colnames with accession instead of IDs
new_cols <- paste0("total_", accessions)

# Assign new colnames back, keeping first col as is
colnames(merged_df) <- c(colnames(merged_df)[1], new_cols)

# Check
head(merged_df)
```
##connect to the expression values
```{r}
long_df <- merged_df %>%

    cols = starts_with("total_"),
    names_to = "accession",

  ) %>%
  mutate(accession = sub("total_", "", accession)) %>%  # remove prefix
  rename(TE = ID_cleaned)

head(long_df)
long_df$accession <- as.numeric(long_df$accession)
merged_df_with_expresssion <- inner_join(long_df,expression_col0,by=c("TE","accession"))
```
